title: Social image
description: A page's link-preview image, 1200 x 630: its section, its title, and the site's wordmark. Pattern Dump renders it for every page without an image of its own (site.socialImages).

title.description: The page's title, three lines at most

section.description: The title of the page's top-level folder, such as "Guide"; none for a top-level page

site.description: site.globals: its title is the wordmark
